headlines.title: Exclusive: US News and World Report Rates GLP-1 Web Providers
headlines.description: As millions turn to online telehealth platforms to get weight loss drugs, U.S. News and World Report is launching its first-ever official evaluation and ratings of GLP-1 online providers. Gretel Schueller, managing editor of health, joins TODAY to share an exclusive look at the list and discuss best practices to find safe medication online.

headlines.title: Breaking Down Common Health Advice: Water Intake, Sleep, More
headlines.description: NBC’s medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY to sort out fact from common medical myths. He also shares his advice for navigating produce shopping amid the rising numbers of recalls, which include buying locally and staying up to date with CDC and FDA guidelines.

headlines.title: Food Safety Concerns in the Spotlight Amid Recall Fatigue
headlines.description: Americans are growing weary of the rising number of recalls related to cyclospora and salmonella outbreaks. The multiple recalls are hitting businesses like Taco Bell and Chipotle hard, after they pulled tainted lettuce and jalapeños from their menus. The FDA and CDC urge consumers to avoid recalled products with a best by date up to and including August 16th. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Signs Executive Order on Childhood Vaccine Schedule
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has issued a new executive order calling for an overhaul of the childhood vaccine schedule that would reduce the number of vaccines kids receive, citing unsubstantiated claims. Critics are blasting the move, saying misinformation could mislead parents. NBC’s Nikki Battiste reports and NBC medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: The best under-bed storage for dorms, small apartments and more
headlines.description: Here are some of the best under bed storage containers to consider when putting away seasonal items. Find options from Open Spaces, Onlyeasy and more.

headlines.description: The best aluminum deodorants block sweat while reducing odor — shop dermatologist-approved options from Secret, Dove, Vanicream and more.

headlines.description: Apple products rarely go on sale, but right now several are up to 34% off for back-to-school season. Shop deals on laptops, iPads, AirPods and more.

headlines.title: Storm season is here — and so is a 25% discount on Crocs rain boots
headlines.description: As hurricane and storm season ramps up, there’s one wardrobe staple you’ll want in your closet: a good pair of rain boots.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order aiming to cut the number of required vaccines for children
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.

headlines.title: How 3 health factors can help delay dementia for up to 13 years
headlines.description: New research from NYU Langone Health found that people who avoid three vascular risk factors in middle age had about 13 more dementia-free years.
